SELECT
    p.payment_method,
    COUNT(*) AS total_attempts,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE p.status = 'successful'
    ) AS successful_attempts,
    ROUND(
        100.0
        * COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE p.status = 'successful'
        )
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        2
    ) AS success_rate_pct
FROM payments AS p
GROUP BY p.payment_method
ORDER BY success_rate_pct DESC, p.payment_method;
